## History

Oliver Sloane was a member of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends. He attended a dismayed gathering of the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) accidentally painted the town hall bright blue instead of green. Later, Oliver was present at a society meeting where the group was distressed to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) planned to rent his fence for patent medicine advertisements.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +69 more_
